document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  gaze  down  upon  alien  horror—a  monster  belched  by 
cosmic  accident  from  a  dimension  of  nightmare.  Somehow 
your sanity holds and you are able to study it.

The  side  of  your  body  that  faces  it  feels  cold,  as  if  the 
creature drains heat energy from its environment. Perhaps for 
nourishment? Starfish-like legs radiate from one malignant eye 
at the center of its body. It looks something like an upright set 
of spokes with no wheel.

Gain 2 points of Cthulhu Mythos. To fire at the creature, go to 167. 
To lay face down and hide until it goes away, make a Stealth roll: if 
you succeed, go to 171; if you fail, go to 169.
